sources.name: pvec
sources.reason: Persistent vector, not a complete key/value snapshot engine. Candidate backing for dense rows, with an explicit key index. Its arc feature is required for cross-thread retained views. First cloning a flat representation constructs a tree; account for conversion and compare tree-start mode as well. small_branch is a separate compile-time variation, requiring its own pinned binary and matched controls. Additional Debug bound must not narrow the generic row API without an explicit wrapper. See vector-and-ordered-map-review.json. Actual pinned API proofs now pass at 20,000 records with retained full-payload views, four reader threads, clone-panic injection and complete tracked-value release. PVec also passes pop failures and both branch sizes. Actual complete-engine adapters exist; full engine/feed proof and comparative timings remain pending. See native-vector-map-proof/evidence/receipt-default-v2.json and receipt-small-v2.json. API clone counters are not runtime performance evidence.

sources.name: scc
sources.reason: Pinned native Clone feeds slot capacity into an entry-count constructor and doubles capacity in chains. Frozen bounded trace confirms 1,024 to 262,144 slots in eight copies at 512 live entries; length-based copying stays 1,024 through 128 copies. Corrected capture adapter passed all 30 full-size checks and four threaded probes; native-copy remains investigative and is not a benchmark win.

sources.name: ordermap
sources.reason: Wrapper over IndexMap providing order-sensitive collection semantics. Clone delegates to the underlying IndexMap. Default remove uses shift removal, while explicit swap_remove delegates to IndexMap swap removal. Adapt actual OrderMap with native/fast builders and explicit removal policy; do not count it as an independent indexing algorithm or infer its measured speed from another crate. See vector-and-ordered-map-review.json. Actual pinned API proofs now pass at 20,000 records with retained full-payload views, four reader threads, clone-panic injection and complete tracked-value release. PVec also passes pop failures and both branch sizes. Actual complete-engine adapters exist; full engine/feed proof and comparative timings remain pending.
